segments.he: תָּקַע בָּרִאשׁוֹנָה וּמָשַׁךְ בַּשְּׁנִיָּה כִּשְׁתַּיִם. אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן: שָׁמַע
segments.en: § The mishna taught: If «one sounded the first» tekia «and» then «extended the second» tekia of that series «to» the length of «two» tekiot, so that it should count as both the second tekia of the first set and the first tekia of the second set, it is considered as only one tekia, and one must begin the second set with a new tekia. «Rabbi Yoḥanan said:» If «one heard»

moves.summary: the mishna's lemma: an extended second tekia counts as one
